title: Integer overflow in the Widget: Win32 component
description: An integer overflow vulnerability has been identified in the Widget: Win32 component of Microsoft software version 4.0. The vulnerability is cataloged as CVE-2026-8949 and is associated with CWE-190. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and there is no indication of known exploitation in the wild. No patch or remediation details are available at this time.
